steps.npc: Good day! I'm here to to teach you about group storage, and to let you access your personal bank. You can call me Maggie. How may I help you?

options.text: How do I use the group storage?

steps.player: How do I use the group storage?

steps.npc: You can access the group storage via the button in the top-left of your bank interface. Only one member of the group may access the storage at one time.
You will then be able to deposit and withdraw items from the group storage. You can't deposit untradeable items.
When you have finished, click the 'Save' button to confirm the transaction.
Can I help you with anything else?

options.text: I'd like to access my bank account please.

steps.player: I'd like to access my bank account please.

steps.npc: This bank is for new adventurers only, you cannot access it as you've already started your Group Ironman journey.

options.text: I'd like to check my PIN settings.

steps.player: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
